features.title: Grounding step in shape-up
features.user_visible_behavior: Before writing a pitch, shape-up grounds it in existing specs, code, and DONE slices and records a Reuse / Extend / New table with evidence; the appetite cites reference slices.
features.evidence: GREEN: skill-eval --skill shape-up 1/1 (grounding-before-pitch: knowledge sync+search and status --metrics --json exit 0; skill has Step 3 Ground the pitch, Reuse / Extend / New, knowledge search, codegraph explore, reference slice, grounding.md link). kit skills-lint --only shape-up PASS.

features.title: Per-scope grounding in product-delivery
features.user_visible_behavior: product-delivery gives each scope a Reuse / Extend / New breakdown and merges or cuts a scope that duplicates an existing capability.
features.evidence: GREEN: skill-eval --skill product-delivery 1/1 (scope-grounding: knowledge slice exit 0; skill has Step 3 Ground the scopes, Reuse / Extend / New, merge or cut, grounding reference); intent fitness gains a 'grounded' check and intent.md a ## Grounding table (asdd-harness-handoff.md). kit skills-lint --only product-delivery PASS.

features.title: PO mode: tracker output only
features.user_visible_behavior: In PO mode shape-up writes the pitch and product-delivery writes one Intent item per fit scope to the configured tracker, in the canonical format, and neither writes repository files.
features.evidence: GREEN: skill-eval total 8/8 (shape-up 2/2: grounding-before-pitch, po-mode-pitch; product-delivery 2/2: scope-grounding, po-mode-intents — the PO-mode reference example has all 7 required headings and the asdd-intent fence). PO mode sections in both skills; po-mode-tracker-output.md lists Jira/Linear/GitHub create, update, comment, search, and sub-issue operations. kit skills-lint PASS for both.

features.title: Ship: copies, versions, full verification
features.user_visible_behavior: The installed skill copies and kit version records match the sources; every gate is green.
features.evidence: GREEN: kit self --check OK; kit skills-lint PASS (22 skills); kit guidance PASS; skill-eval 8/8; npm test 231/231. grounding.md moved to product-delivery/references (skills-spec REQ-002, checked by cli/test/install.sh, forbids product-delivery linking into shape-up/references); stale managed entry removed from installed-versions.json.
